established.meaning: The day OIC 2603/1981 establishes the Environmental Appeal Board under s. 11 of the Environment Management Act, SBC 1981 c. 14 ('effective January 1, 1982, there be established an Environmental Appeal Board'); the order was approved 18 December 1981, which is not the start
established.locator: OIC 2603/1981, approved and ordered 18 December 1981, sole operative paragraph; PDF p. 1

research_events.summary: OIC 2602/1981 directs a proclamation bringing ss. 11 and 12 of the Environment Management Act, SBC 1981 c. 14, into force on 1 January 1982
research_events.meaning: The in-force day the order fixes for the enabling sections; order approved 18 December 1981. The proclamation itself was not retrieved
research_events.locator: OIC 2602/1981, approved and ordered 18 December 1981, sole operative paragraph; PDF p. 1

research_events.summary: First members of the Environmental Appeal Board appointed for two-year terms from 1 January 1982; Francis A. Hillier appointed Chairman
research_events.meaning: The day the first appointments take effect; order approved 18 December 1981
research_events.locator: OIC 2604/1981, paras 1-3 and member list; PDF pp. 1-2

legal_basis.citation: Environment Management Act, SBC 1981, c. 14, s. 11; OIC 2603/1981
legal_basis.locator: OIC 2603/1981, administrative part: 'Authority under which Order is made: Environment Management Act, section 11'

records.note: Round 4 (carried round-3 branches evidence R3F-EXT-003 to -005, read again from the BC Laws originals on 2026-10-21). The 1981 held year is the Act's year, not the Board's; the manual's 1982 agrees with the orders at year precision. The orders were recommended by the Minister of Environment; that is not a statement of which ministry answered for the Board. Its later continuation under the Environmental Management Act, SBC 2003 c. 53 is not dated here.

review.scope: OICs 2602, 2603 and 2604 of 1981 (BC Laws archived OICs)

established.meaning: Incorporation of the company registered as BC0352143, under the numbered name 352143 B.C. LTD.; it took the name Powertech Labs Inc. on 6 January 1989. A legal start, not the start of the laboratory's work
established.locator: BC Registries credential 493544 (BC0352143): registration_date and entity_name_effective 1988-09-29, reason Event:CONVICORP (converted legacy record)

names.name: 352143 B.C. LTD.
names.locator: Credentials 493544 and 493593, same registration BC0352143; the end is exclusive

parents.locator: PDF p. 28, subsidiaries: Powertech Labs Inc.

research_events.summary: 352143 B.C. LTD. changes its name to Powertech Labs Inc.
research_events.meaning: The day the legal name took effect; not a new body and not the start of laboratory operations

research_events.summary: BC Hydro's 2020 service plan says Powertech has operated in Surrey since its inception in 1979
research_events.meaning: A retrospective statement about the laboratory work, written in 2020; not the company's incorporation (1988) and not proof that the 1979 work was the same body
research_events.locator: PDF p. 28, Powertech Labs Inc. subsidiary profile

records.note: Round 4 (carried round-3 branches evidence R3F-EXT-006 and R3F-DOC-101; OrgBook credentials re-read 2026-10-21). The held 1988 is the incorporation year; BC Hydro's 1989 'service delivery' (2009 release) and its 1979 'inception' (2020 service plan) are statements about the laboratory's work, kept as events. The registry does not itself say BC Hydro owned the company from 1988: the identification with today's subsidiary rests on the name. When BC Hydro acquired or subscribed for its shares is open.
